Name: AMF - Genshin Impact Weapons
Author: aziadhim04
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ffff][size=3]Genshin Impact Weapons In Stardew Valley??!![/size][/color]
[size=2]Yes, this is a mod where you can use Staff of Homa, Primordial Jade Winged-Spear, and many more, in Stardew Valley.
Those weapons are really powerful, but you need quite a bit of effort to get them.
Some weapons are obtained by buying them at the Marlon, Clint, Krobus, or Dwarf shops, with certain conditions to be able to buy them.
Some weapons can be forged to get more powerful.[/size][/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ffff][size=3]Update 1.1.0 :[/size][/color]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Udd unique passive and active skills to 5-star weapons, using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7886]Advanced Melee Framework[/url].[/font]﻿
[/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ffff][size=3]Suggestion :[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Use this mod so that the weapon is not too overpowered, [/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6722?tab=description]Stronger and More Random Monsters[/url]. If it's still too overpowered I'll balance it in the future :)[/size][/font]﻿
[/list][/font][font=Comic Sans MS]
[color=#00ffff][size=3][s]Bugs?[/s] No This Is Features :[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]If we kill monster with 5-star weapon and switch it with other weapon. Then the passive skill of the 5-star weapon will be on other weapon that we use. (This [s]bug[/s] feature will disappear if we sleep). [/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Infinite forging (mineral) on 5-star weapons. Yes, you can make level 200 weapon.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=2]
﻿(Sorry i can't [s]fix those bugs[/s] remove those features because i'm dumb >_< ).
